Source: docs/build-plan.md, section 8, package 12.

Architecture assessment, 18 November 2026

Acceptance for EP12. Stream one fixed release or accepted view with INT02's versioned transfer manifest alongside the data. Preserve permitted directories, including empty ones. The CLI and HTTP outputs verify independently against the same canonical inventory. A cancelled or revoked delivery cannot yield a successful completion receipt. Exercise both supported BIDS and archival payloads.
